In ordinary Win32 reservations, reject duplicate targets, duplicate page tokens, and a late invalid mapping while restoring earlier ranges and preserving a foreign committed page. Check ordinal 22 by name.

limits: Ordinary caller-owned reservations retain bytes by copying and accept one live mapping per token. The section-backed Xbox profile supports multiple real CPU aliases. GPU-visible memory and GPU queue page-table updates remain unverified.
Invalid-input details and allocation failure rollback are provider policy; no direct console NT success or error behavior is asserted.
Callers must own and serialize each reservation and keep input arrays outside mapped ranges.
